risks.title: Loss of Key Executives and Professionals
risks.summary: The departure of key portfolio managers could lead to client withdrawals, interruptions in consultant recommendations, and a reduction in AUM and revenues.
risks.score_rationale: The loss of portfolio managers or key members of the executive team could have a material impact on the company. The departure of a manager has in the past contributed to clients' decisions to withdraw funds. APAM relies heavily on its key professionals to maintain performance and attract new clients. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Investment Performance of Strategies
risks.summary: Weak or underperforming investment performance would have a material negative impact on the company due to loss of client confidence and reduction in assets under management.
risks.score_rationale: Poor investment performance could lead to client and revenue losses. The company is highly exposed to financial market fluctuations and depends heavily on the historically strong performance of its strategies to attract and retain assets. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense Competition in Asset Management
risks.summary: High competition in the asset management industry forces APAM to be innovative and deliver high-quality services to attract and retain clients and maintain its fee structure.
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the asset management sector is intense from large global managers and specialized firms. APAM must maintain its fees, service quality, and innovation to remain competitive. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Market Risks and Economic Fluctuations
risks.summary: Unfavorable market conditions, economic crises, or major equity corrections could reduce AUM, affect strategy performance, and decrease APAM's revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in financial markets and adverse economic conditions can have a material negative impact on the company. APAM is exposed to market risks including interest rate changes, market corrections, and economic crises. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Global Stability
risks.summary: Geopolitical crises, regional conflicts, or major trade sanctions could destabilize financial markets, reduce investor confidence, and affect APAM's AUM.
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events such as conflicts, sanctions, and political instability can negatively impact financial markets and investments. APAM is exposed to geopolitical risks, particularly for investments in emerging markets. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Currency Risks and Foreign Exchange Exposure
risks.summary: Significant fluctuations in exchange rates could affect the value of investment portfolios, strategy returns, and APAM's consolidated revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Exchange rate fluctuations can negatively impact the value of managed assets and APAM's revenues. The company is exposed to currency risks, particularly regarding foreign market investments and non-USD revenues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks and Compliance Environment
risks.summary: Regulatory changes, new compliance requirements, or legal amendments could increase operating costs, limit investment strategies, or affect APAM's competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations applicable to asset management, investments, and disclosures could increase operating costs. APAM must comply with a complex and expanding regulatory environment to maintain its operating licenses. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and Liability Risks
risks.summary: Client disputes related to investment performance or portfolio management could result in significant legal fees and reputational damage to APAM.
risks.score_rationale: The asset management industry faces significant litigation risks. APAM could be exposed to claims of negligence, breach of fiduciary duties, contract violations, or fraud, which could lead to substantial legal expenses and reputational harm. (default score, to be refined)
